metadata.title: SAR - DMARC Reporting Not Monitored
metadata.remarks: Assessment result identifying institutional domains where DMARC is present but aggregate reporting is not actively monitored, contrary to DNS Secure Email SSPP expectations.

findings.title: DMARC Reporting Not Actively Monitored
findings.description: DMARC aggregate reporting is configured for one or more institutional domains, but reports are not reviewed, analyzed, or acted upon by an assigned role.

associated-risk.title: Reduced Email Authentication Visibility
associated-risk.description: Without active review of DMARC reports, unauthorized sending attempts, configuration errors, or emerging abuse may go undetected.

remediations.title: Establish DMARC Reporting Monitoring
remediations.description: Define operational ownership, review cadence, and escalation procedures for DMARC aggregate reports.

tasks.title: Assign DMARC Report Ownership
tasks.description: Assign a responsible role to receive and review DMARC aggregate reports.

tasks.title: Define Review Cadence
tasks.description: Document review frequency and escalation thresholds for DMARC findings.
